title: Northloop Payments Frequency Discount for Repeat Instant Payouts
content:
**Rule.** In pricing a Northloop Payments instant payout, Northloop subtracts from the volume-priced rate a frequency rate discount of 0.0015 when at least 6 instant payouts were sent from the account in the last three months, counting the one being charged, 0.0005 when 2 to 5 were sent, and nothing when only the one being charged was sent. The rate so combined is applied once to the payout amount.

A window of the last three months takes in the ledger entries dated after the same calendar day three months before the fee date, up to and including the fee date.

## Discount by count

| Instant payouts sent from the account in the last three months, the one being charged included | Frequency rate discount |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.0015 |
| 2 to 5 | 0.0005 |
| 1 (only the one being charged) | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Five earlier instant payouts in the window plus the one being charged make 6: the discount is 0.0015.
- Four earlier ones plus the one being charged make 5: the discount is 0.0005.
- No earlier instant payout in the window: the count is 1 and no frequency discount is subtracted.
